## Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Treat with intravenous therapy for 4-6 weeks followed by oral azole for at least 12 months.

## Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Treat for 6-12 months. It is recommended that immunocompromised patients be treated with at least 1-2 weeks of intravenous treatment and a total treatment duration of 12 months.

Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment for mild to moderate disease

Itraconazole solution 200 mg PO q8h for 3 days, then 200 mg po q12h for 6- 12 months ($$) [DI]

### Treatment for severe disease

Change to oral itraconazole after the patient's condition has stabilized.

### Oral therapy after disease has stabilized

Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]
< OR >
Fluconazole 400-800 mg PO q24h ($) [R,DI]

### Initial intravenous treatment
